MEMO

To: KYC Onboarding Review File
From: Junior Analyst, Onboarding Operations
Re: Case KYC-2604-823617, summary of materials received
Date of memo: 2026-04-07

1. Purpose

This memo records what was received for the application below. It lists the materials and reproduces them in Appendices A to C. It contains no assessment.

2. Application details

The application was received on 7 April 2026 through the introducer channel. The applicant is requesting a current account in Great Britain (onboarding country GB). The review as-of date is 2026-04-07.

The applicant is named as Nnamdi Ezekwo, born on 30 October 2005, nationality GHA. The residential address given is Flat 9, 147 Amberwood Road, LEICESTER, LE3 5EE. The stated occupation is University student and the employer is given as n/a. The stated source of funds is scholarship. The expected monthly volume is 723 GBP, and the expected activity is described as occasional international transfers to family.

3. Materials received

An identity document, a driving licence issued by GBR, was received. No machine-readable zone lines were present in the OCR output. The OCR text is in Appendix A.

A proof of address was provided: a tenancy agreement from Greystone Lettings dated 21 January 2026. The OCR text is in Appendix B.

The screening report returned one hit, reference H1, against a sanctions list. It is reproduced in Appendix C.
